summary: Iteration 5 — Retest of the dados fix from iteration_4. VALIDATED both backend and frontend. Frontend GameResultToast renders two DiceFace components with visible dots (no multiplier fallback). Regression on tool-numero (ruleta) and tool-mora (rps) still works as expected.

GameResultToast.js lines 30-31 correctly read dice1/dice2 with fallback from top-level OR game_data — compatible with both the dedicated /api/games/dados endpoint (top-level) and the /api/games/play endpoint (game_data).
Note: /api/games/play for 'dados' does NOT top-level-expose dice1/dice2 (only in game_data). Frontend GameResultToast is compatible due to the `??` fallback. Both paths work.
